5.11.5.5.3 Task Termination
Description:
A trace event invoked immediately prior to an RTE generated task
(containing runnable entities) terminating execution. The same task
termination VFB event is used whether the RTE generated task ter-
minates by either a TerminateTask or a ChainTask OS Service
call.
Signature:
[SWS_Rte_06032]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00045
⌈
void Rte_[<client>_]Task_Terminate_<task>(void)
Where <task> is the name of the task.⌋
caption: 5.11.5.5.3 Task Termination
